title: coap_waypoints detail_get/detail_put still use the inline unprotect pattern (read endpoints)
description: Follow-up from 2r8s (which migrated the audited mutating sites): lichen/subsys/lichen/coap/coap_waypoints.c:1032 (lichen_waypoint_detail_get_handler - GET, asserts payload_len==0) and :1064 (lichen_waypoint_detail_put_handler - always NOT_ALLOWED) still call coap_oscore_unprotect_resource_request. These are READ/disallowed endpoints, not the mutating handlers the l9hb epic targets, so they were left on the old API to keep 2r8s's diff scoped. Migrating them to coap_oscore_authorize_mutating is mostly mechanical but detail_get is a read (no method gate to enforce - the helper is mutating-oriented) so confirm the helper fits or keep the read path on the plain unprotect API deliberately with a comment.
close_reason: Obsolete; detail_get/detail_put both use coap_oscore_unprotect_resource_request() + coap_oscore_respond_resource() shared helper pattern.
